reply: Thank you for explaining that several dealers pulled your credit but placed the auto loans only in your husband's name, and that you want the inquiries removed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please review your credit reports, and dispute any inquiry you did not authorize. Shopping for a car loan within a short period usually has a limited effect on your score. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a late payment removed after your dispute has reappeared, and that many on-time payments are now missing from your history. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep the results of your earlier dispute, and file a new dispute with the credit reporting companies, including that result. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you kept making payments while your accident claim was resolved, and that you have questions about how the settlement and GAP coverage were applied. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a payoff breakdown showing the insurance and GAP payments, and keep your payment records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your contract now includes extra months and a warranty you did not agree to, raising the total cost. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep your copy of the original contract, and ask in writing for the signed contract on file and an explanation of each added charge. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle was repossessed after you made a payment, and that you did not receive notice before the repossession. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep proof of your payment and your finance agreement, and ask in writing for copies of any notices sent and the amount needed to recover the vehicle. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you received a message showing knowledge of your work and activities that you never shared with the lender. We understand how unsettling this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep copies of the messages, and send a written request about how and when you want to be contacted. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked to cancel your GAP coverage months ago, and that calls keep ending without a resolution. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send your cancellation request in writing with the date of your first request, and ask for written confirmation and any refund due. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your dispute of the repossession reported on your credit report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain which details you believe are inaccurate and include supporting documents in your dispute with the credit reporting companies. If you disagree with the result, you can add a statement to your file. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your auto loan principal has dropped far less than you expected, and that the rate charged seems higher than your contract. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for your Truth in Lending disclosure and a full payment history showing interest and principal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a repossession account still appears on your credit report after it was sold to a collection agency, and that you would like it removed. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Accurate negative information can stay for a set period, but if any detail is wrong, please dispute it. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the insurance paid $2,700.00 toward a $2,000.00 balance after your accident, and that you have not received an explanation for the difference. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a payoff statement showing how the insurance payment was applied and whether a refund is due. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a repossession on your credit report is shown as involuntary when you believe it was voluntary. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep any records of the voluntary surrender, and dispute the entry with the credit reporting companies, including those records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle was marked as repossessed after it was totaled in a fire, and that calls were made to the wrong number. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send your correct contact details in writing, and ask for an account history showing what happened to the vehicle and the balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that over $3,000.00 in add-on products were added to your auto loan without your consent, and that a credit was later applied without notice. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for the signed contract and an explanation of the credit applied to your balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that it took months for your traded-in lease to be paid off, and that the refund of extra payments was then reversed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lease team. Please keep the payoff and refund records, and ask in writing for a full account history explaining the reversal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle was repossessed after the account had already been charged off, following an earlier repossession attempt you dispute. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the video and your account records, and ask in writing for an account history and the reason for the later repossession. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were injured in a serious accident, cannot work, and are struggling to make your $870.00 car payment along with other bills. We are sorry for what you are going through. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing about hardship options such as a deferment or modified payment, and keep your insurance claim records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle no longer runs, you are behind on payments, and you have not been offered hardship options. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for hardship or settlement options, and keep the repair diagnosis and your loan documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a VIN error led to two lease accounts, causing your payments to go to the wrong one and a late payment to be reported. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lease team. Please ask in writing for the old account to be closed, the payments moved, and the late report corrected. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have paid a lot toward your car but are now threatened with repossession, and that you believe the car had problems from the start. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a payment history and the options available to avoid repossession, and keep your repair records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

We are sorry for the loss of your spouse. Thank you for explaining that your request for a voluntary surrender was refused and that you are now asked to pay a $6,600.00 deficiency. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for the sale details and a breakdown of the deficiency. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your auto account went to collections after a hardship following your mother's death, and that the settlement offered is more than you can afford. We are sorry for your loss. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written settlement or payment offer based on your income, and ask for any agreement in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you could not get clear information about fees and the rate for your refinance, and that you later received a letter saying you were not eligible. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for the specific reasons for the decision and a list of the fees quoted. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you signed one sale contract at the dealership, but a second electronic version with different terms was generated the next day. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep both versions of the contract, and ask in writing which contract is on file and why the terms differ. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that more than 90 days after your vehicle was sold at auction, you still have not received a full accounting of the sale. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for the sale price, the fees and how the proceeds were applied to your account. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid your truck payments in advance as arranged, but are now receiving calls about the account. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the payment confirmation and notes of your call with the manager, and ask in writing how the advance payment was applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car was repossessed, that your wired payment was not visible, and that your servicemember rate request was not met. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the wire confirmation, and ask in writing for the status of your payment and the amount needed to recover the car. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you helped your son get a car you could not afford, without being told the price, and that it has now been repossessed. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a copy of the contract and the balance owed after repossession, and keep your records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid your $1,700.00 payoff in full, the funds have cleared, and you have not received your title. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the title services team. Please keep the payoff quote and proof of payment, and ask in writing for the date the title will be released. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle was repossessed without a chance to collect your belongings, and that the reporting changed while your complaint was open. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing how to recover your personal property, and dispute the reporting with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
